basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a fresh graduate from Belmont University where I studied Computer Science. I'm originally from Nashville, Tennessee, and I'm currently working as a junior software developer. In my free time, I love diving into new games, especially RPGs and strategy games. I also enjoy reading fantasy novels and watching sci-fi movies. I'm pretty new to Reddit, but I'm eager to learn and explore more of the communities here. My online hours are mostly in the evenings and weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending time with my friends and family.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in programming and software development thanks to my degree in Computer Science. I also spend a lot of time learning about game mechanics and strategies through online forums and gameplay videos. My knowledge is mostly self-taught through experimentation and participation in gaming communities.
